title: Emoji Sort
seo_title: Emoji Sort — Play Free Emoji Pattern & Sorting Puzzle Online
meta_desc: Play Emoji Sort free online. Read emoji patterns, categories and sequences to fill the missing emoji in each grid — a light logic sorting puzzle.
desc: Emoji Sort is a pattern puzzle dressed in emoji. Each grid hides a rule — a category, a sequence or an association — and one cell is missing its emoji. Read the pattern, pick the right face, and keep the streak alive.
howto: Study the filled emoji cells in the grid.
Work out the hidden pattern, sequence or category.
Pick the emoji that completes the missing cell.
Confirm your answer and move to the next grid.
Patterns get subtler as the levels climb.
tips: Check rows and columns separately before assuming diagonals.
Look for emoji categories like food, weather or faces first.
Counting repeats quickly reveals sequence-based rules.
